adversarial_analysis.proto_inherited_fields: Not a realistic threat in T-0021 threat model: Grant.resourceFacet arrives from JSON.parse (Object.prototype only, no custom proto chain) in both static-now (in-memory fixture) and T-0053 (DB JSON) paths. A proto-polluted facet object requires code-level attack on the GrantSource port itself — a separate trust boundary violation. Adding hasOwnProperty guards is theoretically tighter but disproportionate (axis-5) for this vector with no realistic injection path.
adversarial_analysis.getter_on_facet: Getters pass through the current code, but getters are not injectable from JSON.parse or DB ORM output — purely a code-level attack path on GrantSource, not a T-0021 surface.
adversarial_analysis.symbol_keys: Safe by construction: (facet as Record<string,unknown>)['fields'] uses a string key; Symbol-keyed properties are invisible to string lookup, so result is undefined => falls through to [] (fail-closed).
adversarial_analysis.array_subclass: Safe: Array.isArray returns true for subclasses; string filter applied regardless.
